description: Read the experiment one of your routing policies runs and how far it has got: each arm with the function it runs and the calls it recorded, the experiment's status, the promoted winner (every call the policy routes then runs its function), and any arm of the stored experiment the policy gives no function. status says where it stands: not released for your workspace yet, not configured, waiting for the first routed call, running or promoted. Only the default policy routes calls. Read only. Leave policy_id out for your default policy. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.

policy_id.description: The routing policy UUID. Leave it out to read your workspace's default policy.

name: get_routing_experiment
